OBJECT_IDENTITY.rationale: File-open success is not integrity evidence. A truncated HDF5 still opens and still serves its first blocks as valid data - this project had a local NIH-CARD download fail truncated at 6,059,254,368 of 14,508,702,462 bytes without erroring loudly. A receipt must therefore bind the identity of the bytes it read, not merely report what it measured.
OBJECT_IDENTITY.read_mode: HTTP byte-range against the authoritative URL; NOT a local copy

final_rna_data.h5ad.md5_verification_note: NOT verified: verifying the md5 requires reading all bytes, which is exactly the 33 GB transfer the range-read design avoids. The binding here is authoritative LENGTH plus the publisher's declared digest, and the gap is stated rather than papered over.

final_atac_data.h5ad.md5_verification_note: NOT verified: verifying the md5 requires reading all bytes, which is exactly the 33 GB transfer the range-read design avoids. The binding here is authoritative LENGTH plus the publisher's declared digest, and the gap is stated rather than papered over.

OBJECT_IDENTITY.local_copy_status: final_atac_data.h5ad FAILED TRUNCATED at 6,059,254,368 of 14,508,702,462 bytes (58% missing) and curl exited 0. h5py REFUSES to open it. final_rna_data.h5ad completed at 18,439,154,935 bytes. No measurement in this receipt derives from local bytes; all reads were HTTP byte-range against the authoritative URLs.

1_count_like_rna_slot.important: raw/X is NONINTEGER_LOG_LIKE float32. The convention is REVERSED relative to the common AnnData layout where .X is normalised and raw/X holds counts. Any pipeline assuming the usual layout would silently analyse log values as counts.
1_count_like_rna_slot.caveat: COUNT_LIKE means integer-valued and nonnegative in the sampled values only; it does not establish raw or CellBender-corrected provenance.

2_exact_shared_barcodes.cause: the ATAC index repeats the sample suffix: RNA 'AAACAGCCACGTGCTG-1_HBCC-1193' vs ATAC 'CCTATAGCAATATAGG-1_HBCC-1193_HBCC-1193'
2_exact_shared_barcodes.note: both files hold exactly 1,501,089 nuclei and the (sample, raw_barcode) composite matches 1:1 with no residual, which is consistent with the same nuclei under two spellings - but the probe refuses to assert pairing without an explicit operator assertion, which is the point of the repair.

3_donor_label_mismatches.note: reported as not-checkable rather than as zero mismatches; 'not checkable' is not a pass

5_microglia_with_paired_atac.THE_REPAIR_IN_ACTION: v1.0 of this probe would have reported 0 here. On this real deposit that would have read as 'NIH-CARD has no paired microglia', which is almost certainly false.

9_available_covariates.note: ATAC obs carries only cohort/sample_id/cell_type/barcode/fragment counts; donor covariates live on the RNA side

rna_genes.note: MIXED symbols and Ensembl IDs in one index (e.g. 'OR4F5' next to 'ENSG00000290826'). Feature identity must be resolved on stable IDs, not on symbols.

atac_peaks.note: cohort-defined CONSENSUS peak universe; usable only as a measurement-support restriction applied identically to linked and matched-unlinked pairs, never as construction evidence

QUALIFICATION.rule: QUALIFIED_FOR_PAIRED_USE requires an exactly resolved namespace, ZERO donor-label mismatches across shared nuclei, and available microglia and paired-microglia counts. An operator-asserted composite basis does NOT satisfy pairing_resolved.

FEASIBILITY_READING.microglia_depth: 87,384 microglia over 357 donors, median 217 per donor. But 45 donors have fewer than 50 and 167 of 357 have fewer than 200. Per-donor microglial depth is the binding constraint on any within-donor aggregation, not the headline total.
FEASIBILITY_READING.cohort_asymmetry: NABEC 202 donors / 56,240 microglia / median 256.5 vs HBCC 155 donors / 31,144 / median 157. HBCC donors are systematically shallower, so cohort and depth are confounded and must not be compared naively - which is also why the PMI diagnostic must be run WITHIN cohort.

governance.exposure: schema, metadata and bounded value sampling only; NO RNA-ATAC relationship computed; no biological outcome opened
governance.nih_card_role: VALIDATION CANDIDATE ONLY - its peaks and any derived links must never enter E2 construction

CORRECTION_2026_09_29.what_was_wrong: This receipt's OBJECT_IDENTITY.rationale asserted that 'a truncated HDF5 still opens and still serves its first blocks as valid data'. That is FALSE for the truncation actually observed, and I verified it rather than leaving it standing.
CORRECTION_2026_09_29.evidence: h5py refused the 6,059,254,368-byte file outright: OSError 'Unable to synchronously open file (truncated file: eof = 6059254368, sblock->base_addr = 0, stored_eof = 14508702462)'. HDF5 records the expected end-of-file in its superblock and checks it.
what_is_still_true: The acquisition step reported SUCCESS (curl exit 0) on a file missing 8,449,448,094 bytes, 58% of the object. The -C - resume flag did not recover it.
No measurement in this receipt derives from those local bytes; the probe ran over HTTP byte range against the authoritative URL, and both observed content-lengths match Zenodo exactly.
final_rna_data.h5ad DID complete at 18,439,154,935 bytes, so the failure was file-specific and silent rather than an obvious total failure.
CORRECTION_2026_09_29.corrected_rationale: Integrity binding is required because the ACQUISITION step can report success on an incomplete object. It is NOT required because readers fail to notice truncation - HDF5 does notice, via its superblock length. But that is a format-specific safeguard: gzip streams, BED/CSV text and partially-read tar members have no declared total length and will yield a prefix that parses cleanly. Making correctness depend on which format happened to be involved is not a property to rely on, so completeness is verified at acquisition rather than left to the parser.
CORRECTION_2026_09_29.class: self-correction of a claim I made confidently in a committed artifact
